name: octo-apm-ai-studio-token-cost
displayName: OCTO APM - AI Studio GenAI token & cost
description: AI Studio multi-agent LLM spans with per-call token usage and estimated USD cost. Drill down to Langfuse for prompt/completion + eval scores and to Grafana for the FinOps cost dashboards.
queryText: show (traces) TraceId, gen_ai.request.model as Model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens as InTokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens as OutTokens, gen_ai.usage.cost_usd as CostUSD, gen_ai.agent.name as Agent, ServiceName as Service, studio.run_id as RunId where ServiceName = 'octo-genai-studio' and gen_ai.request.model != null order by CostUSD desc

external_drilldowns.name: Langfuse
external_drilldowns.why: Inspect prompt/completion, token usage, cost, and LLM-as-judge scores for this run.

external_drilldowns.name: Grafana FinOps
external_drilldowns.why: Token cost attribution and GenAI spend dashboards (LLM FinOps).
